sectors.name: Logistics
themes: US freight rate normalization and e-commerce restocking are driving a durable repricing cycle, with asset-light forwarders (EXPD, CHRW) outperforming asset-heavy carriers on margin expansion.

Digital freight matching and AI-driven route optimization are permanently lowering cost curves, favoring tech-enabled operators (CASS, SAIA) over traditional brokers in both markets.
sectors.ai: Buy logistics exposure now: US freight names are repricing on peak-season demand and margin recovery, while Indonesian players lag but offer asymmetric upside on domestic consumption. Rotate into TRUK, SOCI, and EXPD for momentum, add TAMU for local volume leverage. Trim laggards into strength, hold through Q4 earnings catalysts.
